items.prompt: This grid has 2 rows of 3 squares. How many squares of any size are there?

figure.alt: A grid of 2 rows and 3 columns, 6 small squares in all.

options.why: A 3 by 3 square does not fit. The grid has only 2 rows.
Some shapes you counted are rectangles, not squares.
Count only shapes with 4 equal sides.
18 counts all rectangles. Only squares count here.

hints: Count small squares, then bigger squares.
A bigger square uses 2 rows and 2 columns.
A 2 by 2 square can start in the first or the second column.
items.explanation: There are 6 small squares and 2 squares made of 2 by 2 small squares. That makes 6 + 2 = 8 squares.

solution.say: 2 by 2 squares: one on the left, one on the right.

items.prompt: The minute hand of a clock points to 12. It makes three quarters of a full turn clockwise. Which number does it point to now?

figure.alt: A clock with the minute hand pointing to 12.

options.why: A quarter turn ends at 3. Three quarters goes further.
A half turn ends at 6. Three quarters goes further.
Each quarter turn moves 3 numbers: 3, 6, 9.
Three quarter turns move the hand 9 numbers from 12, not 10.

hints: A full turn goes all the way round back to 12.
A quarter turn from 12 ends at 3.
Each quarter turn moves the hand 3 numbers on.
items.explanation: A quarter turn from 12 ends at 3, a half turn at 6 and three quarters of a turn at 9.

items.prompt: Two squares have sides of 3 cm. They are put side by side to make a rectangle. How long is the line all the way around the rectangle?

figure.alt: Two squares side by side make a rectangle. Each square has sides of 3 cm.

options.why: 12 cm goes around one square only.
The rectangle has 6 small edges of 3 cm on the outside, not 5.
The rectangle has 6 small edges of 3 cm on the outside, not 7.
24 cm goes around both squares, but the side in the middle is not on the outside.

hints: Draw the rectangle and mark the outside edges.
The rectangle is 6 cm long and 3 cm wide.
Count the 3 cm edges on the outside of the rectangle.
items.explanation: The rectangle is 6 cm long and 3 cm wide. Around it is 6 + 3 + 6 + 3 = 18 cm. The side where the squares touch is inside, so it does not count.

solution.say: Or count the outside edges: 6 edges of 3 cm.

items.prompt: Ana folds a paper square in half. She cuts a half circle out of the folded edge. Then she opens the paper. What shape is the hole?

figure.alt: A half circle, the shape Ana cuts out of the folded edge.

options.why: The fold makes a mirror copy of the half circle.
A heart has a point. The cut has no points.
The half circle was cut on the fold, so the two halves join together.
Curved cuts cannot make a square.

hints: The fold works like a mirror.
The cut goes through both layers of paper at the fold.
Picture the half circle and its mirror copy joined at the fold.
items.explanation: Cutting on the fold cuts both layers at once. When the paper opens, the half circle and its mirror copy join along the fold to make a full circle.

solution.say: The cut goes through both layers.
They meet along the fold line.
Opened up, they make a circle.

items.prompt: Kim draws a square. She joins each corner to the opposite corner with a line. How many triangles can you find?

figure.alt: A square with two lines crossing in the middle. Each line joins a corner to the opposite corner. The lines cut the square into 4 small triangles.

options.why: Each line alone makes 2 triangles, but there are 2 lines.
Look for bigger triangles made of 2 small ones.
Count the big triangles again. There are 4.
Each line makes 2 big triangles, so there are 4 big ones.

hints: Count the small triangles first.
Two small triangles next to each other can make a bigger triangle.
Each line on its own cuts the square into 2 big triangles.
items.explanation: There are 4 small triangles. Each of the 2 lines also cuts the square into 2 big triangles, which makes 4 big triangles. So there are 4 + 4 = 8 triangles.

solution.say: One line cuts the square into 2 big triangles.
The other line does the same.

items.prompt: A shape is drawn on squared paper. It covers 5 whole squares and 4 half squares. How many whole squares is it the same as?

options.why: The 4 half squares cover some space too.
4 halves make 2 whole squares, not 1.
Half squares count as half, not as whole squares.

hints: Two half squares make one whole square.
Pair up the 4 half squares.
4 half squares make how many whole squares?
items.explanation: 4 half squares make 2 whole squares. Add the 5 whole squares: 5 + 2 = 7 whole squares.

items.prompt: A big cube is built from small cubes. It is 3 cubes long, 3 cubes wide and 3 cubes tall. How many small cubes are used?

figure.label: 3 by 3 by 3
figure.alt: A big cube made of small cubes, 3 cubes long, 3 cubes wide and 3 cubes tall.

options.why: 9 cubes make only one layer.
There are 3 layers of 9, not 4.
Count the layers again: 3 layers of 9.

hints: Think of the big cube as layers.
One layer is 3 rows of 3 small cubes.
How many small cubes are in one layer?
items.explanation: One layer has 3 rows of 3, which is 9 small cubes. There are 3 layers, so 9 + 9 + 9 = 27 small cubes.

items.prompt: Leo faces north. He makes a quarter turn clockwise. Then he makes a half turn. Which way is he facing now?

options.why: A quarter turn and a half turn do not bring him back to the start.
He faces east after the quarter turn, but then he turns again.
Check the first turn. A quarter turn clockwise from north faces east.

hints: Draw a compass: north at the top, east on the right.
A quarter turn clockwise from north makes him face east.
A half turn makes him face the opposite way.
items.explanation: A quarter turn clockwise from north faces east. A half turn from east faces the opposite way, which is west.

solution.say: Half turn: face the opposite way.

items.prompt: Three squares with sides of 2 cm make an L shape. What is the distance all the way around the L shape?

figure.alt: An L shape made of 3 squares: two squares side by side at the bottom and one square on top of the left one. Each square has sides of 2 cm.

hints: Only the outside edges count.
Count the small outside edges of the L. Each edge is 2 cm.
Trace the outline with your finger and count the small edges.
items.explanation: The L shape has 8 small edges on the outside. Each is 2 cm, so the distance around is 8 × 2 = 16 cm.

solution.say: Trace the outline and count the small edges.
The 2 edges where squares touch are inside, so they do not count.

items.prompt: A grid has 4 rows of 4 small squares. How many squares of any size can you find?

figure.alt: A grid of 4 rows and 4 columns, 16 small squares.

hints: Count each size of square separately.
The sizes are 1 by 1, 2 by 2, 3 by 3 and 4 by 4.
A 2 by 2 square can be in 3 places across and 3 places down.
items.explanation: There are 16 squares of size 1, 9 of size 2, 4 of size 3 and 1 of size 4. That is 16 + 9 + 4 + 1 = 30.

items.prompt: Meja Ibu berbentuk persegi panjang. Panjangnya 4 jengkal dan lebarnya 2 jengkal. Ibu memasang renda di sekeliling pinggir meja. Berapa jengkal renda yang dibutuhkan?

figure.alt: Meja berbentuk persegi panjang, panjangnya 4 jengkal dan lebarnya 2 jengkal.

options.why: 6 jengkal hanya panjang ditambah lebar. Renda mengelilingi keempat sisi.
8 adalah 4 kali 2. Itu bukan panjang pinggir meja.
Hitung lagi: dua sisi panjang dan dua sisi lebar.

hints: Renda dipasang di keempat sisi meja.
Meja punya 2 sisi panjang dan 2 sisi lebar.
Jumlahkan dulu kedua sisi panjang: 4 + 4.
items.explanation: Keliling meja adalah 4 + 2 + 4 + 2 = 12 jengkal. Jadi renda yang dibutuhkan 12 jengkal.

items.prompt: Lantai teras ditutup ubin persegi. Ada 4 baris, setiap baris 4 ubin. Ubin di pinggir berwarna merah. Ubin lainnya putih. Berapa ubin putih?

figure.alt: Lantai teras dengan 4 baris ubin. Setiap baris berisi 4 ubin, semuanya 16 ubin.

options.why: Hitung lagi ubin yang tidak menyentuh pinggir.
12 adalah banyak ubin merah di pinggir.
16 adalah semua ubin, merah dan putih.

hints: Gambar 4 baris dengan 4 ubin.
Ubin putih adalah ubin yang tidak menyentuh pinggir.
Baris paling atas dan paling bawah semuanya merah.
items.explanation: Baris atas dan bawah semuanya merah. Di dua baris tengah, hanya 2 ubin tengah yang putih. Jadi ubin putih ada 2 + 2 = 4.

solution.say: Baris pertama dan keempat semuanya di pinggir.
Di baris kedua dan ketiga, ubin paling kiri dan paling kanan merah.

figure.alt: Lantai 4 kali 4 ubin. Empat ubin di tengah yang diarsir adalah ubin putih.

items.prompt: A round martabak is cut with 3 straight cuts. Every cut goes through the centre. How many pieces are there?

figure.alt: A round martabak seen from above, before it is cut.

options.why: Each cut through the centre goes right across the martabak.
4 pieces come from only 2 cuts through the centre.
8 pieces need 4 cuts through the centre.

hints: Draw a circle and try it.
One cut through the centre makes 2 pieces.
Each new cut through the centre crosses the other cuts and adds 2 pieces.
items.explanation: The first cut makes 2 pieces. Each new cut through the centre adds 2 more pieces, so 3 cuts make 2 + 2 + 2 = 6 pieces.

items.prompt: A garden is a rectangle, 6 m long and 4 m wide. A post stands at every corner. There is also a post every 2 m along the sides. How many posts are there?

figure.alt: A rectangle garden 6 m long and 4 m wide. Posts stand at every corner and every 2 m along each side.

options.why: Count the posts in the middle of the sides too.
Corner posts are shared by two sides. Count them once.
14 counts every corner post twice.

hints: Find the distance all the way around.
Around the garden is 6 + 4 + 6 + 4 metres.
On a closed loop, the number of posts equals the number of 2 m gaps.
items.explanation: The distance around is 6 + 4 + 6 + 4 = 20 m. That is 10 gaps of 2 m. On a closed loop there is one post for each gap, so there are 10 posts.

solution.say: On a loop the last gap ends at the first post, so posts and gaps match.
Check: long sides have 4 posts, short sides 3, and the 4 corners are shared.

items.prompt: A big square is made of 4 small squares. The distance around the big square is 24 cm. What is the distance around one small square?

figure.alt: A big square made of 4 small squares in 2 rows of 2. The distance around the big square is 24 cm.

hints: Find the length of one side of the big square.
A square has 4 equal sides. 24 cm is shared between them.
Each side of the big square is made of 2 small sides.
items.explanation: Each side of the big square is 24 ÷ 4 = 6 cm, which is 2 small sides, so a small side is 3 cm. One small square measures 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 = 12 cm around.
